name: 2-NP
summary: 1-(2-Naphthyl)piperazine (2-NP), also known as 1-deazaquipazine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative serotonergic psychedelic of the arylpiperazine family related to quipazine.

pharmacology.text: 1-(2-Naphthyl)piperazine (2-NP), also known as 1-deazaquipazine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative serotonergic psychedelic of the arylpiperazine family related to quipazine. It shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1, 5-HT2, and 5-HT3 receptors and is known to act as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor partial agonist.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen
